name: Lola Glidden
source: She’s the president of the cosplay club and known for supplying not only cosplay or unique outfits, but also custom made clothing for students. She’s a very down to earth, aloof girl who seems to be very open and saying kinky things without so much as a second thought of being embarrassed. She wishes to use Brandon as a model for her cosplay projects and get his input on her outfits.
